form.title: Request to book
form.intro: Tell {company} who is driving and how you would like to pay. They review your request before anything is charged.
form.returnDescription: You pick the car up at {location}. Bring it back there, or to another {company} branch.
form.notesHint: Flight number, a child seat, a late pick-up, or anything they should know.
form.needAttention: {count, plural, =1 {One field above needs your attention.} other {# fields above need your attention.}}

failures.unavailable: This vehicle is no longer available for those dates. Change your dates and try again.
failures.pickup_in_past: That pick-up time has already passed. Change your dates and try again.
failures.location_unavailable: The company is not handing over vehicles at this branch right now. Contact them to arrange a pick-up.
failures.rejected: The company's system did not accept these details. Check them and try again.
failures.failed: The request could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.

driver.title: Your details
driver.description: The main driver's details, used for the rental agreement.
driver.name: Full name
driver.nameHint: As it appears on your driving licence.

documents.title: Licence and insurance
documents.description: Clear photos let the company check your documents before you arrive. JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to 10 MB each.

payment.title: Payment preference
payment.description: You are not charged when you send this request.
payment.legend: How would you like to pay?
payment.timingLegend: When should the deposit be secured?

online.title: Pay online
online.description: {company} emails you a secure payment link once they accept your request.

cash.title: Pay in cash
cash.description: Pay {rental} when you collect the car. {company} will tell you how the deposit is taken.

rentalFirst.title: Rental now, deposit at pick-up
rentalFirst.description: Pay {rental} online. The {deposit} is secured on your card when you collect the car.

allAtOnce.title: Rental and deposit together
allAtOnce.description: Pay {rental} and secure the {deposit} in one online payment. Nothing left to do at pick-up.

errors.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
errors.phoneCharacters: Use only digits, spaces and + ( ) - in a phone number.
errors.phoneLength: Enter a phone number with 7 to 15 digits.
errors.birthFuture: Your date of birth must be in the past.
errors.birthTooYoung: You must be at least {minAge} to rent.
errors.birthYear: Check the year of your date of birth.
errors.licenceCharacters: Use only letters, numbers, spaces and hyphens.
errors.licenceLength: Enter a licence number of 3 to 30 characters.
errors.expiryBeforeReturn: Your licence must be valid until you return the car.
errors.licencePhotoRequired: Add a photo of your driving licence.
errors.insurancePhotoRequired: Add a photo of your insurance card.
errors.photoType: Upload a JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC photo.
errors.photoSize: Upload a photo of 10 MB or less.
errors.paymentMethodRequired: Choose how you would like to pay.
errors.paymentTimingRequired: Choose when to pay the deposit.

summary.cappedHours: A day is billed as {hours} hours.
summary.deposit: A refundable security deposit of {amount} is released when the car comes back.
summary.noRate: {company} has not set a rate for this vehicle and will confirm the price with you.

confirmed.title: Request sent
confirmed.body: {company} has your booking request. Your reference is <ref>{reference}</ref>.
confirmed.uploading: Sending your documents… Keep this page open until they are through.

uploadFailed.licence: Your driving licence photo did not upload.
uploadFailed.insurance: Your insurance card photo did not upload.
uploadFailed.both: Your driving licence photo and insurance card photo did not upload.

notArrived.licence: Your driving licence photo has not arrived.
notArrived.insurance: Your insurance card photo has not arrived.
notArrived.both: Your driving licence photo and insurance card photo have not arrived.

confirmed.retryOrBring: Your request is with {company} either way. Try again now, or bring the {count, plural, =1 {document} other {documents}} to pick-up.
confirmed.bring: Your request is with {company} either way. Bring the {count, plural, =1 {document} other {documents}} to pick-up.

steps.review: {company} checks the dates, your details and your documents.
steps.cashConfirm: They confirm the booking by email to {email}.
steps.cashPay: You pay in cash when you collect the car.
steps.onlineLink: They email a secure payment link to {email}.
steps.allAtOnce: You pay the rental and secure the deposit together, and the booking is confirmed.
steps.rentalFirst: You pay the rental and the booking is confirmed. The deposit is secured at pick-up.

confirmed.notCharged: Nothing has been charged. Your dates are held while the company reviews the request.

statusPage.caption: Booking {reference}
statusPage.loadFailedBody: Try again in a moment, or contact {company} if it keeps happening.
statusPage.invalidBody: Check the link, or contact {company} with your booking reference.
statusPage.confirmedBody: {company} accepted request {reference}. Check your email for what comes next.
statusPage.cancelledBody: Request {reference} is no longer active. Contact {company} if you did not expect this.
statusPage.otherBody: This rental is under way or finished. Contact {company} with any question.
